qa_pairs.question: How are Ansys service packs integrated into module versions starting with Ansys 2024 on clusters?
qa_pairs.answer: Starting with Ansys 2024, a separate Ansys module will appear on the clusters for each service pack, indicated by a decimal and two digits after the release number (e.g., `module load ansys/2024R1.03` for Service Pack 3). Most users can load the latest service pack by simply doing `module load ansys`.

qa_pairs.question: What is the typical procedure for running an Ansys Fluent job on Alliance clusters?
qa_pairs.answer: The typical procedure involves preparing the Fluent job on a desktop, exporting the case and optionally data files, transferring these files to a directory on the `/project` or `/scratch` filesystem on the cluster, creating a journal file to load files, run the solver, and write results, and finally submitting the job. After the job runs, data can be downloaded and imported back into Fluent.

qa_pairs.question: Why are special instructions required for submitting parallel Ansys jobs on Alliance clusters?
qa_pairs.answer: Special instructions are needed for each Ansys package because none of the multiple Message Passing Interface (MPI) implementations included in the Ansys software suite natively support the Slurm scheduler used on Alliance clusters for parallel computation.
